title: A-klinikkasäätiön muutosneuvottelut ohi – 11 työsuhdetta päättyy
content:
A-klinikkasäätiön muutosneuvottelut ovat päättyneet. Neuvottelujen seurauksena 11 työsuhdetta päättyy ja viiden työntekijän työsuhteen ehdot muuttuvat olennaisesti.

Tiedotteensa mukaan säätiö varautuu sopeutuksilla ennakoivasti vuoden 2027 STEA-rahoituksen merkittävään vähenemiseen. Henkilöstövähennysten lisäksi säätiö karsii muun muassa toimitila-, osto- ja palvelukuluja.

A-klinikkasäätiöllä työskentelee tällä hetkellä 49 henkilöä.

Säätiön toiminnan lopullinen laajuus ensi vuonna selviää, kun STEA-rahoituksesta saadaan päätökset. Säätiö sanoo varautuneensa siihen, että sen STEA-rahoitus voi vähentyä noin 30 prosenttia.

MIKÄLI rahoitusta leikataan, Oulun Katuklinikan toiminta päättyy, Helsingin ja Tampereen matalan kynnyksen kohtaamispaikkojen toimintaa supistetaan ja digipalveluja, kuten Päihdelinkkiä ja Nuortenlinkkiä, tuotetaan jatkossa pienemmällä henkilöstöllä.

A-klinikkasäätiön mukaan sen palveluissa kohdataan vuosittain noin 13 000 ihmistä. Apua tarjotaan verkossa, jalkautuvassa ja etsivässä työssä sekä matalan kynnyksen palveluissa. Lisäksi säätiö tekee addiktioihin liittyvää tutkimus- ja kehittämistyötä.

title: Bangladesh: New Laws Reverse Rights Protections, Empower Abusers
content: (London, September 23, 2026) – Three laws approved in September 2026 by the Bangladeshi parliament have reversed human rights protections and broken the ruling Bangladesh Nationalist Party’s (BNP) commitments to reform, Human Rights Watch said today. The legislation removes safeguards created by the interim government, which ruled Bangladesh between August 2024 and February 2026, reducing protections that could prevent a return to violations such as enforced disappearances and extrajudicial killings which were widespread in the past.

title: Suurenmoista! tuo lavalle aimo annoksen glamouria ja suurta ystävyyttä – Satu Silvon tähdittämä näytelmä antaa luvan rakastaa elämää
content:
Suurenmoista!-komedianäytelmän harjoitukset ovat pyörähtäneet käyntiin Hämeenlinnan Teatterissa syyskuun alussa. Keväällä käynnistetty tuotanto alkaa kesätauon jälkeen saada muotonsa – kerroksia syntyy sekä hahmoihin että suhteisiin, mutta myös pukuihin ja lavasteisiin.

Tunnelma syksyn harjoituskauden alussa, reilua kuukautta ennen ensi-iltaa, on innostunut ja kupliva. Ohjaaja Katja Krohnia jännitti, pystytäänkö harjoituksissa pitämään keväällä saavutettu nousujohde myös syksyn harjoituskaudella. Huoli on ollut turha. “Hahmot tulevat monimutkaisemmiksi hyvällä ja kirkkaalla tavalla. Kerroksia alkaa tulla, se on hyvä vaihe.”

Harjoituksissa rakennetaan näyttelijä Satu Silvon roolihenkilö Florence Foster Jenkinsin esityksiä, sekä ääripäiden tunteiden valtaan heittäytymistä. Silvo on tehnyt tarkkaa taustatyötä roolihenkilönsä parissa pitkin kesää. “Siellä on se kaikki haavoittuvuus, kipu ja sairaudet, mutta teemme kuitenkin komediaa. Teos kertoo oikeasta ihmisestä, mutta tämä on meidän tarina.”

title: New UK agency will tackle ‘information warfare’ from likes of Russia, Burnham says
content:
PM aims to ‘stem poisonous tide’ of disinformation and deepfakes with National Centre for Information Defence

Security chiefs will set up a new national centre to tackle disinformation and deepfakes from hostile states such as Russia, Andy Burnham has announced, saying the government had a duty to “stem the poisonous tide” from damaging British interests.

The National Centre for Information Defence will “detect, attribute and disrupt” information attacks by foreign powers, many of which are enabled by AI, bringing together the intelligence agencies, law enforcement and social media companies.

title: Voiko vyöruusurokote pienentää myös muistisairauksien ja sydän- ja verisuonitautien riskiä?
content:
Viime vuosina on julkaistu useita tutkimuksia, joissa vyöruusurokotteen ja muistisairauksien välillä on havaittu kiinnostava yhteys.

Vuonna 2025 Nature-lehdessä julkaistussa Walesissa tehdyssä tutkimuksessa tarkasteltiin vyöruusurokotteen yhteyttä uusiin dementiadiagnooseihin. Tutkimuksessa vyöruusurokotteen saaneilla arvioitiin olevan seitsemän vuoden seurannassa noin 20 prosenttia pienempi todennäköisyys saada uusi dementiadiagnoosi kuin niillä, jotka eivät saaneet rokotetta.

Samansuuntainen tulos saatiin Australiassa tehdyssä, vuonna 2025 JAMA-lehdessä julkaistussa tutkimuksessa. Siinä vyöruusurokotteen saaneilla todettiin 7,4 vuoden seurannassa 1,8 prosenttiyksikköä pienempi todennäköisyys saada uusi dementiadiagnoosi kuin niillä, jotka eivät olleet oikeutettuja rokotteeseen.

Useissa tutkimuksissa yhteys pienempään dementiariskiin on havaittu sekä vanhemmalla elävää heikennettyä virusta sisältävällä vyöruusurokotteella, että nykyään Suomessakin käytössä olevalla uudemmalla rekombinanttirokotteella, joka ei sisällä elävää heikennettyä virusta.

title: Kauppa iloitsee: Ruokahävikki pienenee koko ajan
content:
Hävikkiruuan määrä on vähentynyt päivittäistavarakaupassa jälleen aiemmasta. Päivittäistavarakauppa ry kertoo, että hävikiksi jäi viime vuonna enää 0,92 prosenttia ruuan kokonaismyynnistä.

Laskelmat ovat Luonnonvarakeskuksen arvioita.

Useissa kaupoissa on tehty improvisoituja ratkaisuja myyntiaikansa menettäville tuotteille, kuten erillisiä hävikkihyllyjä joista ruokaa myydään isoilla alennuksilla.

Myös tilausmääriä pystytään kaupoissa etukäteen ennakoimaan aiempaa paremmin todellisen kysynnän mukaan.

Kaupan etujärjestön mukaan ruokahävikki onkin saatu vähenemään yli 40 prosenttia vuodesta 2018.

Huomattavasti kauppaa enemmän ruokaa menee hukkaan ravintoloissa, joissa hävikkiprosentti on liki 19 prosenttia. Etenkin noutopöydissä ruokaroskaa jää päivän päätteeksi paljon.

HÄVIKKIRUUAN väheneminen on ympäristölle hyvä asia, mutta toisaalta se on johtanut muun muassa ruokalahjoittajamisen ongelmiin. Leipäjonoihin ja ilmaisruokaa jakaville vapaaehtoistoimijoille ei enää riitä kaupoista tarpeeksi jaettavaa.

title: Salavapuiston avajaisissa ohjelmaa koko perheelle
content:
Avajaisten ohjelma on suunniteltu erityisesti lapsia ja perheitä ajatellen, mutta kaikki kiinnostuneet ovat tervetulleita juhlistamaan uudistunutta leikkipaikkaa ja Sirkusbambi-veistosta. Leikkipaikalle pääsee leikkimään heti tapahtumasta lähtien. Puiston peruskorjaus jatkuu vielä avajaisten jälkeen viimeistelytöillä.

Kello 15.00 Punaisen nauhan leikkaus ja leikkipaikan virallinen avaaminen.

Kello 15.30 Kaupunginjohtaja Kirsi Ronnun juhlapuhe ja Sirkusbambi-taideteoksen julkistaminen. Teoksen taiteilija Jasmin Anoschkin kukitetaan.

Kello 16.00–16.50 Maisteri Molton lastenkonsertti. Maisteri Molto on omalaatuinen musiikinopettaja, jossa on ripaus klovnia ja hyppysellinen kapellimestaria. Konsertissa kuullaan musiikkia muun muassa klarinetilla, bassoklarinetilla, tenorisaksofonilla ja nokkahuilulla – laulua ja tanssia unohtamatta.

Avajaisissa on tarjolla mehua ja pientä naposteltavaa lapsille. Paikalla voi tavata kaupungin edustajia ja kuulla lisää puiston uudistuksesta. Mukana tapahtumassa on myös nuorisopalveluiden Kerbiili-auto.

title: Mediatutkimus: Suomalaiset haluavat yhä lukea erilaisia lehtiä
content:
Suomalaiset ovat edelleen aktiivisia sanoma- ja aikakauslehtien lukijoita, kertoo alan tutkimus. Tekoälysisällöistä lukijoilla on jyrkkä mielipide.

Tämän vuoden Kansallisen Mediatutkimuksen mukaan painetut tai digitaaliset sanomalehdet tavoittivat viikoittain 93 prosenttia suomalaisista ja aikakauslehdet kuukausittain 81 prosenttia.

Tämä merkitsee, että sanomalehtiä lukee viikoittain noin neljä miljoonaa suomalaista, aikakauslehtiä kuukausittain noin 3,5 miljoonaa.

Lukeminen on viime vuosina siirtynyt entistä enemmän painetusta sanasta digitaaliselle puolelle. Pelkästään painettua sanomalehteä lukevien osuus on kolmessa vuodessa laskenut 40 prosentista 32 prosenttiin.

Digitaalisesti sanomalehtiä lukevien osuus on pysynyt tasaisena yli 60 prosentissa.

Aikakauslehtiä luetaan enemmän painettuna kuin sanomalehtiä. Painettuja aikakauslehtiä lukee kuukausittain 63 prosenttia, digitaalisia 62 prosenttia.

TUTKIMUKSESSA kysyttiin nyt ensimmäistä kertaa kansalaisten näkemyksiä tekoälyn käytöstä mediassa.

Vastaajista 91 prosenttia halusi tietää, jos mediasisältö on tehty tekoälyllä. Alle 35-vuotiaat pitivät tätä vielä tärkeämpänä kuin vanhemmat ikäryhmät.

title: Saamelainen nykytaide ensimmäistä kertaa laajasti esillä Britanniassa
content:
Marraskuussa Lontoon Somerset Housessa avautuu Through our Eyes: Sámi Art and Culture, ensimmäinen Isossa-Britanniassa järjestettävä saamelaiseen nykytaiteeseen keskittyvä ryhmänäyttely. Suomen Britannian- ja Irlannin-instituutti on näyttelyn keskeinen tukija ja osaltaan mukana tuomassa saamelaista nykytaidetta näkyväksi brittiläiselle yleisölle.

title: Ukraine war briefing: Zelenskyy ready for ‘energy ceasefire’, as Nato warns Putin becoming ‘increasingly cavalier’
content:
Meeting on sidelines of UN general assembly, Ukrainian leader says Kyiv open to deal not to attack energy targets if Russia agrees. What we know on day 1,673

Volodymyr Zelenskyy discussed with Donald Trump on Tuesday efforts to end the 4-year-old war with Russia, ⁠including a potential bilateral ceasefire ​on energy-related targets. “We are ready for any kind of format of energy ceasefire” if Russia agrees to “not attack our energy system,” Zelenskyy told journalists after meeting with Trump at the UN headquarters in New York. The Ukrainian leader expressed hope the “American side will find a way … to bring them to any kind of negotiations.” Zelenskyy said that he also was ready to meet the Russian president, Vladimir Putin, ​at a trilateral meeting with Trump.

title: ‘We Hacked the FBI:’ Hackers Say They Have Data on All FBI Employees
content:
A high profile hacking group claims it has breached multiple FBI-related services and stolen data “on all FBI employees and applicants.” A representative of the group, called ShinyHunters, told 404 Media the data includes FBI agents’ names, home addresses, phone number, and information on their spouse.

The data breach could be massively significant and may have all sorts of national security and counterintelligence implications. Criminals from the same ecosystem as ShinyHunters have previously used hacked data like phone records to track, intimidate, and harass the FBI agents investigating them. The highly sensitive data could also be a boon to foreign intelligence agencies who want to better understand how one of the most important law enforcement and intelligence agencies in the U.S. operates. And if the data fell into the hands of more criminals, FBI agents and their spouses could face serious threats to their safety.

“We hacked the FBI. We hold data on all FBI employees and applicants,” the representative of the group told 404 Media.

title: Ecuador: Militarization Continues and the Armed Forces Still Refuse to Cooperate
content:
One year after the publication of the report “It was the military. I Saw Them“, which documented the enforced disappearance of 10 people from the Ecuadorian coast, including six children, in the context of President Daniel Noboa’s so-called “Plan Fenix”, some progress has been made. Nevertheless, the lack of cooperation by the Armed Forces in the criminal investigations and the deepening of the policy of militarization of the public security continue to be the main obstacles preventing all victims’ families from obtaining truth, justice, and reparation, and from ensuring the non-repetition of these crimes, Amnesty International said today. 

“The progress achieved over the past year demonstrates that it is possible to respond to the demands for truth and justice made by the families, civil society, and international mechanisms. Yet this progress remains insufficient as long as many of those families continue not knowing what happened to their loved ones and the military authorities continue to withhold essential information for the investigations,” said Ana Piquer, Regional Director for the Americas of Amnesty International.

title: OKM:n kysely tekoälyn vastuullisesta kehittämisestä ja käyttämisestä
content:
Opetus- ja kulttuuriministeriön alainen tekijänoikeusasioiden neuvottelukunta käynnisti loppuvuodesta 2025 pienryhmätyöskentelyn vastuullisen tekoälyn kehittämisestä ja käyttämisestä. Pienryhmiä oli yhteensä kolme:

  • Luovaan työhön keskittyvä pienryhmä
  • Teknologiaryhmä

title: Explainer: How sea level rise poses an ‘existential threat’ to humans, heritage and nature
content:
For millions of people around the world, rising sea levels are already reshaping economies, livelihoods and cultures.

The world’s oceans are currently rising at a faster rate than at any time in at least the past three millennia, with human influence the “dominant cause” of sea level rise since at least 1970.

At the UN general assembly in New York this week, world leaders are set to adopt a high-level declaration on the “existential threats” posed by sea level rise. 

The declaration notes: “Sea level rise is not a distant scenario, but a real and lived experience for many.”

On average, global sea levels rose by 20 centimetres (cm) between 1901 and 2018. 

This is due to both the melting of glaciers and ice sheets and the expansion of seawater as it warms, as well as changes in land-water storage.

The rate of the rise has accelerated in recent years, with ocean levels rising 10.6cm since 1993. 

Sea level rise can vary locally due to seismic and volcanic activity, groundwater extraction and changes to the Earth’s surface resulting from ice melt.

content:
Toukokuussa 2026 julkaistut ilmastokaksosen uudet simulaatiot olivat merkittävä edistysaskel kohti entistä tarkempaa ilmastotietoa. Näihin simulaatioihin perustuva sektorikohtainen tieto on nyt saatavilla Destination Earth-alustan kautta. Julkaistu tieto tukee tutkimusta, ilmastonmuutokseen sopeutumista ja tietoon perustuvaa päätöksentekoa eri puolilla Eurooppaa.

Euroopan komission Destination Earth -lippulaivahankkeeseen kuuluva ilmastokaksonen tuottaa maailmanlaajuista ilmastotietoa kilometriluokan resoluutiolla. Yksi ilmastokaksosen keskeisistä vahvuuksista on ilmastomallien ja sektorikohtaista tietoa tuottavien sovellusten yhdistäminen. Tämä mahdollistaa sen, että ilmastosimulaatioita ja sektorikohtaista tietoa voidaan tuottaa samanaikaisesti tarkalla alueellisella ja ajallisella resoluutiolla. Sektorikohtaiset sovellukset jalostavat simulaatioiden tuloksia eri sektorien käyttöön soveltuvaksi tiedoksi ja indikaattoreiksi. Ne on kehitetty yhteistyössä eri alojen käyttäjien kanssa.

title: "Pedagogy of the Oppressed" Brazilian Educator Paulo Freire Profiled in Film, "Reading the World"
content:
Reading the World is a remarkable new documentary about Paulo Freire, the acclaimed Brazilian educator whose revolutionary approach to teaching connected literacy to critical thinking and democratic participation. It draws on rare archival footage of 1960s Brazil and weaves together the memories of farmers, students and educators who took part in Freire’s culture circles, his method of teaching adults to read in as little as 40 hours by drawing on their own lives, communities and experiences. At the time, Brazil’s illiterate population was barred from voting, so education also opened the door to political participation. The experiment was abruptly halted in 1964 when Brazil’s military overthrew President João Goulart in a U.S.-backed coup that led to Freire’s imprisonment and exile.

“Paulo Freire was one of the most influential educators of the past century and is still widely studied all around the world. But the studies often focus on his ideas, his philosophies, his books, and much less is known about his original praxis,” says co-director Catherine Murphy.

title: Kiista Grönlannista ratkesi turvallisuussopimukseen – toistaiseksi
content:
Yhdysvallat, Tanska ja Grönlanti allekirjoittivat tiistaina New Yorkissa sopimuksen, jonka on tarkoitus parantaa arktisen alueen turvallisuutta ja lopettaa Yhdysvaltain valloitushalut Grönlannissa.

Yhdysvaltain puolelta allekirjoittajana oli presidentti Donald Trump, joka aiemmin on sanonut sopimuksen ratkaisevan kaikki Yhdysvaltain huolet ja antavan Yhdysvalloille pysyvän määräysvallan Grönlannin turvallisuuteen liittyvissä asioissa.

Grönlannin pääministeri Jens-Frederik Nielsen sanoi ennakkoon sopimuksen tunnustavan Grönlannin edut ja aseman.

Tanskan pääministeri Mette Frederiksen oli niin ikään ilmaissut tyytyväisyytensä sopimukseen.

Allekirjoitustilaisuudessa osapuolet vaikuttivat tyytyväisiltä, ja matkan varrella olleet kiistat vaihtuivat kohteliaisuuksiin.

- Grönlannille tämä ei ole vain sopimus meistä, vaan se on sopimus meidän kanssamme ja se ottaa huomioon grönlantilaiset ja meidän oikeutemme, toimeentulomme ja maamme kehittymisen, Nielsen sanoi allekirjoitustilaisuudessa.

Hän nosti esille, että grönlantilaiset ovat, ovat aina olleet ja pysyvät jatkossakin vahvoina Yhdysvaltain ystävinä.

title: Warm Makassar, A Note on Collaboration Along WikiRempah’s Journey to Eastern Indonesia
content:
Ever since the Makassar meetup was first announced online, members of the Wikimedia Makassar Community have welcomed the initiative with remarkable warmth and openness.

Led by Sekar Jarwo Soekarno and Iripseudocorus, the Wikimedia Makassar Community succeeded in significantly increasing both participant attendance and the volume of contributions produced during the event, results that were clearly visible when tracked through our laptops.

It is no exaggeration to say that the enthusiasm of our friends in Makassar was extraordinary. Their energy was so strong that it could even be felt by Wikimedia communities from other islands. This included us in the WikiRempah team Ana_Ainina, Supardisahabu, and Sofi Solihah, who came from Java Island, Gorontalo, and Manado respectively.

Both the local contacts and participants responded enthusiastically and showed a strong willingness to work together in increasing contributions to Buginese Wikipedia, the Makassarese Wikipedia Incubator, and the Buginese Wiktionary Incubator.

This enthusiasm was apparent from the very beginning of the event. Participants arrived early and came prepared to take an active part in the activities.

title: ESG-tiedonantovaatimukset murroksessa 27.10.2026
content:
ESG-tiedonantovaatimukset murroksessa – mitä sääntely edellyttää sijoittajan, rahoittajan ja pörssiyhtiön näkökulmista?

EU:n kestävyysraportoinnin ja -tiedonannon sääntely elää poikkeuksellisen nopeaa muutosvaihetta. Omnibus I on jo voimassa, tarkistettuja ESRS-standardeja voi alkaa pian soveltaa, ja SFDR-uudistus etenee lainsäädäntöprosessissa. Muutokset eivät vähennä kestävyystyön merkitystä, mutta ne muuttavat sitä, kuka raportoi mitäkin ja kenelle.
Tule aamiaistilaisuuteemme kuulemaan, mitä Omnibus I:n soveltamisalan muutokset, tarkistetut ESRS-standardit ja SFDR-uudistus tarkoittavat käytännössä.

Ohjelmassa on ajankohtaiskatsauksen ohella paneelikeskustelu, jossa keskitytään ESG-tietoihin liittyviin kysymyksiin liiketoiminnan kannalta. Aihetta käsitellään kolmesta eri näkökulmasta: rahoittajan, joka tarvitsee kestävyystietoja rahoitettavilta yrityksiltä; sijoittajan, joka sekä pyytää dataa portfolioyhtiöiltään että kehittää yhtiöidensä vastuullisuustyötä; sekä pörssiyhtiön, joka raportoi suoraan CSRD:n nojalla ja vastaa samalla sekä sijoittajiensa että rahoittajiensa tietopyyntöihin.

Panelisteina:

  • Elina Erkkilä, ESG Director, OP Pohjola

title: Canada-EU alliance could be “beacon” for other democracies, Carney says. Australia is interested, Kyiv worries
content:
European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen’s State of the Union address stirred debate around the idea of a new form of closer association between Canada and the EU. Just a day later, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney also took the floor in parliament. 

He clearly welcomed the idea of his country becoming a closer partner of the Union. He noted that a large majority of Canadians also support closer ties with Brussels and outlined how he envisages the functioning of the “new alliance”.  

“We are not fair-weather allies. We do not pursue zero-sum deals. Our commitment to the rule of law and our unyielding defence of human dignity, individual freedom and democracy share the same deep roots,” he said during his Thursday speech in Strasbourg. 

Carney noted that the world is currently being shaken by new challenges, from climate shocks and the undermining of democratic institutions to the weaponisation of the economy and various unfair practices by technology platforms.

title: PA Education joins discussion on supporting vulnerable young people into adulthood
content:
EUSBSR Policy Area Education will contribute to a workshop on supporting vulnerable young people as they move from adolescence into adulthood during the European Week of Regions and Cities in Brussels on 14 October 2026.

The workshop, “No child left behind: building bridges to adulthood”, will examine what happens when young people move beyond child-focused services and encounter fragmented systems across education, employment, housing, health and social support.

Participants will discuss how local and regional actors can create more integrated and youth-friendly pathways through coordinated support, early guidance, tailored referrals and stronger cooperation across sectors and levels of governance. The discussion takes place in the context of the EU Anti-Poverty Strategy and the strengthened European Child Guarantee.

Anders Bergström, Policy Area Coordinator for EUSBSR Policy Area Education at Norden Association Sweden, will take part as a speaker.

The workshop forms part of the European Week of Regions and Cities, taking place in Brussels in October. EUSBSR is participating in several activities during the week, including its own discussions on macro-regional cooperation.

title: From north to south, protests sweep across Tunisia: Is change at hand?
content:
Protesters are demanding development, jobs and dignity, the same slogans that drove the 2011 revolution

Originally published on Global Voices

Screenshot from video ‘Tunisians protest against the president: Critical infrastructure struggling to cope in summer’ on the Al Jazeera English channel on YouTube. Fair use.

This article, by Basma Barakat, was originally published in The New Arab on September 18, 2026. This edited version is republished on Global Voices as part of a content partnership agreement. 

Several Tunisian provinces are witnessing growing popular protests demanding development, jobs and dignity, the same slogans that drove the revolution that erupted on January 14, 2011.

For the first time since then, the general public are joining unemployed people in protesting, frustrated after years of unfulfilled promises, unenforced laws and deteriorating conditions.

Protests erupted on Thursday, September 17, following a large mobilisation in Menzel Bouzaiane, Sidi Bouzid province, the birthplace of the 2011 revolution. Continuing the escalation, a second mobilisation took place on Wednesday under the slogan “Work, freedom, national dignity.”

title: Myanmar: Women Political Prisoners Tortured, Ill-treated
content:
(Bangkok) – The Myanmar military junta subjects women political prisoners to torture, sexual violence, and life-threatening denial of medical care, Human Rights Watch said today.

Among the over 30,000 political prisoners detained since the junta’s February 2021 coup are about 6,600 women and 640 children. Former prisoners and their families have reported beatings, rape, squalid conditions, and the dangerous and sometimes deadly denial of prenatal and obstetric medical care to pregnant women. The junta should urgently and unconditionally release all women political prisoners and their children, including the former leader Aung San Suu Kyi, who has been detained for more than five years.

“Women who have been detained as political prisoners in Myanmar paint a deeply disturbing picture of a prison system in which suffering and neglect are both deliberate and routine,” said Bryony Lau, deputy Asia director at Human Rights Watch. “The women face layers of injustice, from arbitrary arrest to torture and mistreatment in detention, to unrelenting fear and trauma following release.”

MOSCOW | 22 September 2026 (IDN) — As the Federal Republic of Nigeria prepares for the 2027 presidential election, the Obidient Movement is seeking to build on the political momentum it generated around Peter Obi’s 2023 candidacy.

The movement attracted significant support among younger Nigerians and sections of the country’s professional and diaspora communities. title: TPS ja Ihmisoikeusliitto: Ihmisoikeudet kuuluvat urheilun ytimeen
content:
Lauantaina 3.10. pelattavan TPS–JYP-ottelun yhteydessä nostetaan esiin Ihmisoikeusliiton Älä riko urheilua -kampanjaa.

Turussa pelataan lauantaina 3.10. TPS:n ja Ihmisoikeusliiton yhteinen teemaottelu, kun TPS kohtaa Gatorade Centerissä JYPin. Yhdenvertaisuusottelussa nostetaan esiin Ihmisoikeusliiton Älä riko urheilua -työtä ja sen ydinviestiä: Ihmisoikeudet kuuluvat urheilun ytimeen. TPS ja Ihmisoikeusliitto haluavat yhdessä olla rakentamassa urheilumaailmaa, jossa jokainen voi urheilla turvallisesti ja omana itsenään. Kampanjan viestit näkyvät laajasti ottelutapahtumassa. TPS pelaa ottelun erikoispaidoissa, ja paitojen tuotot ohjataan Ihmisoikeusliiton Älä riko urheilua -työhön.

Ihmisoikeudet eivät vielä toteudu urheilussa kaikille. Haasteita on niin rakenteissa, toimintatavoissa kuin arjen tilanteissakin, eikä jääkiekko ole tästä poikkeus. Älä riko urheilua -kampanjan sanoin: Urheilu on rikki, jos lapsen oikeuksia ei turvata, jos rasismiin ei puututa järjestelmällisesti, jos sukupuolten tasa-arvo ei toteudu, jos seksuaali- ja sukupuolivähemmistöt eivät voi urheilla omana itsenään tai jos vammaisilla ihmisillä ei ole yhdenvertaista mahdollisuutta urheilla.

title: Why investigative teams fall into conflict — and what to do about it
content:
A room full of investigative journalists closed their eyes, took a sheet of A4 paper and followed a set of instructions. Fold it in half. Tear off the upper right corner. Fold it again. Tear off the lower right corner. No questions were allowed.

When they opened their eyes and unfolded the paper, the results were markedly different. Some had intricate patterns. Others were little more than shredded paper.

For Emma Thomasson, who was leading a workshop on communication and conflict at IJ4EU’s UNCOVERED Conference in Budapest, the exercise illustrated a basic problem in collaborative work: giving people the same instructions does not mean they will understand them in the same way.

“The point here is that communication is difficult, and particularly difficult if we are not all from the same background,” said Thomasson, a former Reuters bureau chief who now offers training and consulting on leadership, communication, innovation and workplace wellbeing.

title: Meeting with Commissioner for Startups, Research and Innovation Ekaterina Zaharieva
content:
Last week, COMMUNIA joined IFLA, LIBER and SPARC Europe for a meeting with Ekaterina Zaharieva, Commissioner for Startups, Research and Innovation, to discuss the upcoming European Research Area (ERA) Act.

During this constructive exchange, we highlighted two priorities: an EU-wide secondary publication right to make publicly funded research openly available, and a general scientific research exception to create a harmonised copyright framework that enables researchers across Europe to use and build on copyright-protected research materials.

As we have argued  since the beginning of this mandate, Europe must remove persistent barriers that prevent libraries and other knowledge institutions from fulfilling their public mission, particularly in the digital environment. The ERA Act offers an important opportunity to address these barriers and help turn the “Fifth Freedom”—the free movement of researchers, knowledge and technology across the EU—into a reality.

We thank Commissioner Zaharieva and her cabinet for welcoming us and engaging with our proposals. We look forward to the Commission’s proposal for the ERA Act and to continuing this dialogue as the legislation takes shape.

title: The New Influence Machine
content:
A slew of recent reporting has looked at how a new generation of lobbyists is emerging to shape the Trump administration’s views, change their policies or advocate for causes. These figures are not traditional lobbyists, but people with influence over and access to key members of the Trump administration, often extending all the way to the White House and Trump family. Last week, Anne Applebaum described in The Atlantic, how “informal envoys, private companies, online grifters, and hardened ideologues both inside and outside the government matter more,” than traditional ways of lobbying, diplomacy and policy making. CBS News investigated and interviewed pardon brokers, who charge hundreds of thousands of dollars to petition the White House for clemency, going around the Department of Justice. They justified their fees with costs including fundraising dinners and trips to Mar-a-Lago. Politico Influence reported that a Gen-Z online content creator is conducting influence operations for an Israeli defence company, in at least his second foreign lobbying contract. 

Curious how this reporting aligned with larger patterns and areas of concern, ACDC revisited some of the data analysis for our July report into foreign lobbying for high-risk individuals. In that report, we found a thriving and lucrative “leniency lobby” that seeks to secure U.S. political support, pardons and sanctions relief for individuals from around the world who have been implicated in corruption, human rights abuses and other offenses.

title: Kirjasto puntarissa
content:
Kirjastolaki ei määrittele tarkasti, kuinka paljon henkilöstöä kirjastossa pitäisi olla tai kuinka suuret tilat tarvitaan. Siksi kirjastojen on tärkeää osoittaa palvelujensa laatu ja riittävyys itsearvioinnin avulla.

Aiempi kirjastolaki antoi nykyistä tarkempia lähtökohtia kirjastopalvelujen järjestämiseen. Opetus- ja kulttuuriministeriö saattoi esimerkiksi antaa suosituksia henkilöstön määrästä ja kirjaston pinta-alasta, joihin kirjastot pystyivät vetoamaan hakiessaan lisäresursseja.

Kymmenen vuotta sitten voimaan tullut nykyinen kirjastolaki jättää enemmän harkintavaltaa kunnille ja kirjastoille. Samalla vastuu palvelujen kehittämisestä ja niiden laadun osoittamisesta on siirtynyt entistä vahvemmin kirjastoille itselleen.

Siksi kirjastojen työn keskeinen väline on itsearviointi, johon myös kirjastolaki velvoittaa. Sen avulla kirjasto voi arvioida, vastaavatko palvelut kuntalaisten tarpeita ja toteutuvatko lain tavoitteet käytännössä.

”Laki ei määrittele palveluille vähimmäistasoa, vaan palvelun taso määrittyy itsearvioinnin kautta”, sanoo Lupa- ja valvontaviraston kirjastotoimen ylitarkastaja Virpi Launonen.

For any country with an FOI regime, oversight is vital — otherwise, there’s nowhere for people to turn when the system fails.

title: Why China Will Rule AI
content:
In his 2013 book, “The End of Power,” Moisés Naim famously wrote that “power no longer buys as much as it did in the past. In the twenty-first century, power is easier to get, harder to use—and easier to lose.”

That may be true for deconstructed authority in the West, but it is not true in China where the weighty center of authority remains in the un-deconstructed Communist Party. There, power is hard for others to get, easily used and nearly impossible ever to lose.

This systemic incapacity of open societies puts them at a disadvantage when it comes to ruling frontier AI models.

Endless appeals about the dangers of unleashed AI from rosters of the most eminent scientists, Papal encyclicals and monarchical meditations gain no effective traction. The public is warily confused and feels helpless to affect the set course of events. By and large, legislators appear hopelessly clueless and slow on the draw as AI development exponentially accelerates.

title: Albanian Court Orders House Arrest for Intelligence Chief
content:
An Albanian court has ordered the director of the State Intelligence Service (SHISH), Vlora Hyseni, to be put under house arrest and suspended from public duty as part of a sweeping investigation into public tender fraud, the Special Prosecutor’s Office (SPAK) announced Tuesday. The development prompted Prime Minister Edi Rama to announce her immediate removal from office.

The Special Court against Corruption and Organized Crime (GJKKO) approved the security measures at the request of SPAK. Prosecutors are investigating Hyseni for allegedly assisting a perpetrator of a criminal offense and disclosing state secrets.

However, the house arrest order could not be immediately executed because Hyseni was in Baku, Azerbaijan, attending an international conference of intelligence service heads when officers searched her apartment.

Speaking from New York, Prime Minister Edi Rama said Hyseni’s dismissal is immediate and that he will consult President Bajram Begaj to appoint a successor, emphasizing that the court must determine her guilt or innocence independently.

title: How Alan Turing and His Fellow Codebreakers Broke the Nazis’ “Unbreakable” Enigma Code
content:
There was a time when you could just go out and buy an Enigma machine. In the early nineteen-twenties, any organization with a need to keep its communications secret could order a few of those brand-new devices from Germany and rest assured that any messages encoded using them would be safe from prying eyes. It didn’t take long for the military to catch on to the Enigma’s usefulness. Just a few years after the machine came on the market, it had been adopted by the German Navy, Army, and Air Force, and made possible the rapid, secret coordination central to the technique we now call blitzkrieg. When World War II began, Axis forces were confident, as anyone in possession of an unbreakable code might well be.

As history played out, of course, that code turned out to be breakable. That this came as a surprise to the Nazis makes sense if you watch the new video above from Veritasium, which opens up an actual Enigma machine and explains its inner workings. Each letter typed into its keyboard passes through a series of interchangeable rotors wired together, then comes back through in the opposite direction, resulting in a particular substitute letter.

title: The FBI Anti-Corruption Squad Was Circling Susan Collins — Until Trump Got in the Way
content:
In the final weeks of 2019, a top fundraiser for Sen. Susan Collins walked into a perilous meeting at a Corner Bakery in Washington, D.C.

For the first time in her two-decade Senate career, the Republican lawmaker from Maine was in danger of losing her seat. President Donald Trump’s dismal approval ratings were dragging her down in the polls, and she was falling behind her likely 2020 Democratic challenger in fundraising.

Scott Reed, head of the Collins super PAC, was on a mission to close that gap. Reed was meeting that day with three executives from a Hawaiian defense contractor, Navatek. A year earlier, Collins had helped their company land a multimillion-dollar Navy research contract in Maine. Now, seated at a coffee shop not far from the U.S. Capitol, Reed asked them for a $500,000 donation.

Government contractors are banned from making political contributions. More consequentially, for the company to offer donations to Collins in exchange for an official action, or for Collins to accept, would constitute criminal bribery.

title: New Research Paper on Federal AI-CSAM Prosecutions
content:
Together with Cyndie Demeocq at U of Edinburgh, today I’m releasing a paper analyzing 71 federal criminal cases, filed around the US from 2022-2025, that somehow involve AI-generated or -morphed CSAM or child obscenity. It's available on SSRN here.

We’re also releasing the dataset of cases (with an appendix of 2026 cases) on GitHub. Our hope is that this data will be useful to others. I believe this is the largest public collection of federal AI-CSAM cases to date (though I assume there’s an internal list at DOJ).

Our top-line finding: existing laws are working just fine in AI-CSAM prosecutions, at least in the cases prosecutors chose to bring. (We can’t know what cases they decided not to bring, or why.) Most defendants pled guilty (as usual); the few who went to trial all got convicted. Prison sentences are longer than average for CSAM or obscenity cases. Out of 71 cases studied, only half a dozen are still pending.

title: Ny bok utforskar pepparkakans rika och kryddstarka historia
content:
Hur blev ett exklusivt medeltida läkemedel en av Nordens mest älskade kakor? I den nya boken Pepparkakor. En kryddig historia berättar mat- och måltidsforskaren Yrsa Lindqvist historien om bakverket som färdats genom århundraden, kontinenter och kulturer.

 En doft av kanel, nejlika och kardemumma väcker minnen till liv, och få kan tänka sig att fira jul utan knapriga, väldoftande pepparkakor. Som en självklar del av julfirandet förenar kakan tradition och kreativitet – samtidigt som den bär på en komplex historia.

– I pepparkakan möts vardag och högtid, medicin och njutning, vilket gör den till ett bakverk med ovanligt många lager, en smak som bär på minnen, omsorg och fest, säger Yrsa Lindqvist.

I Pepparkakor följer Lindqvist kakans resa från det forna Egypten till dagens julbord. Under medeltiden såldes pepparkakor som läkemedel och ansågs kunna lindra allt från magbesvär till melankoli, och först långt senare blev de ett sött bakverk för en bred publik. Samtidigt speglar pepparkakans historia en större berättelse om kryddhandel, medicin, globalisering och koloniala erövringar.

title: Cybercriminal group claims to steal thousands of FBI employee records
content:
The FBI said it is investigating a possible breach into its online jobs portal, after a prolific cybercrime group publicly claimed to have stolen personal information of FBI personnel.

“The FBI is aware of claims regarding unauthorized activity affecting FBIjobs.gov and is currently investigating,” the FBI National Press Office said in a statement.

Confirmation of an ongoing investigation came hours after a cybercriminal group known as ShinyHunters posted a message online claiming it had stolen “very sensitive” data on “almost all” FBI agents, as well as those who had applied for jobs at the bureau.

The group provided a sample of stolen data affecting 5,000 supposed FBI agents to 404 Media, which first reported on the alleged hack. The sample data set included agent names, home addresses, phone numbers and information on agents’ spouses, the outlet said.

title: Why banning AI in the classroom will not be enough to remedy poor reading skills in a post-literary society
content:
Policymakers are sounding the alarm about AI and social media in schools, as PISA’s latest report confirmed that student performance in reading continues to decline. French Education minister Édouard Geffray lamented the “cognitive destruction” of a generation, while his Spanish counterpart, Milagros Tolón, recommended a focused effort to improve reading because “reading is the foundation of everything”.

The Economist’s editorial board called it a “slow-moving catastrophe”, emphasising that “while machines are getting brighter (… ) teens are getting dimmer”, and pinned blame on the weak, “radical” leftists in university education departments. Meanwhile, the “radical left” is taking meaningful action. On September 2, shortly before the publication of the PISA scores, New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced a ban on student-facing generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) use in New York City public schools from pre-school through eighth grade (approx. 4-14 years of age), to be complemented by “twice-yearly AI critical thinking modules for high schoolers, limited AI pilots for a small number of high school classrooms and age-appropriate screen time restrictions”.

title: Lula’s UN address points to two starkly different visions of Brazilian nationalism ahead of crucial election
content:
When Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva addressed the United Nations General Assembly on Sept. 22, 2026, the Brazilian president posed a question to both an international and domestic audience: Who is to decide Brazil’s future?

It is an unusually pressing question this year. Voters in Latin America’s largest nation head to the polls on Oct. 4, marking the culmination of a campaign defined by a greater degree of U.S. interference than any election in recent memory. Although President Donald Trump has established a surprising personal rapport with the left-wing elder statesman, the U.S. administration doesn’t hide its preference for Flávio Bolsonaro. He is the son of the disgraced former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is currently serving a lengthy sentence after being convicted of attempting to overturn the results of the 2022 election.

Lula has responded to U.S. pressure – which has included tariffs, sanction threats and revoked visas – by making sovereignty a central theme of his campaign, arguing that Brazil’s political destiny must be set by Brazilians rather than what he sees as a capricious foreign power.

title: Public Data, AI, and the Future of the Catalog
content:
The following is taken from remarks delivered on the “AI and Government Data” panel at the AI for Library, Archives, and Museums 2026 conference.

I begin by addressing how we might define public data. It is, in short, data whose value is not determined by the marketplace, by its commodification, or by what Marx would call its “use value.” Public data may function in all of these ways, but its value is defined by something more abstract and less quantifiable. It serves civil society, and without it, an intrinsic public good—the health and safety of a polity, the protection of an environment, the advancement of creative and critical thinking—would be lost.

As stewards of the past and curators of the present who work in service of the future, we in libraries, archives, and museums have long turned our attention to cultural heritage—both in its material and digital forms—for their value as public goods. In the United States, we have, since the first Census in 1790, more or less “Render[ed] therefore unto Caesar” the production and dissemination of information produced by the government for the governed.

title: Finnish Photonics Hub Joensuu Opens New International Test Program for Experts
content:
The City of Joensuu, one of Europe’s leading photonics hubs, has launched Test Joensuu, a new international residency-style program designed for a photonics professional, researcher, entrepreneur, or light artist seeking to develop an idea, project, product or collaboration within a world-class photonics ecosystem.

Applications for the program are open from September 21 to October 4, 2026. One participant will be selected for a visit to Joensuu, Finland, from November 20 to 29, 2026. The City of Joensuu will cover the travel and accommodation costs.

Unlike traditional international promotion efforts that take expertise abroad, Test Joensuu brings global talent directly into the innovation environment where research, education, technology companies, and creative industries work side by side.

“Joensuu is internationally recognized for its strong photonics expertise, but we are continuously looking for new ways to showcase our capabilities. Test Joensuu creates genuine opportunities for interaction between researchers, companies, students, and international experts,” says Markku Pyykkönen, Marketing Director of the City of Joensuu.

title: Trump invades the UN with a brutish speech | Ted Widmer
content:
Gone was any shred of US idealism. It was a spectacle of raw power – a power that is likely to only diminish in the years ahead

Expectations were low for Donald Trump’s address to the UN on Tuesday, and yet somehow it was even worse than expected. He does not perform well in formal settings, like chambers of government, preferring a blingier room, like Mar-a-Lago, or an outdoor rally. For years, he has made no secret of his hostility to the UN, and the very principles of international order that define it.

In recent years, that hostility has deepened into something more like a full-on assault, with frequent attacks on the International Criminal Court (perhaps out of fear that he will someday be indicted), on the UN’s climate agenda, and on Unesco (which the US decided to withdraw from in July 2025).

title: CoE/ViPS Invited Seminar October 2026
content:
Date: 7th October 2026

Time: 13:00

Title: Photosynthesis Phenotyping: From Stress Sensing to Mechanisms and Genetics

Location: Seminar room 1015, Biocentre 2, Viikinkaari 5 

Host: Alexey Shapiguzov

Abstract: Improving the resource-use efficiency and resilience of plant photosynthesis is widely regarded as a key strategy in crop breeding to safeguard food security under global climate change. As our understanding of photosynthetic reactions and their regulatory mechanisms has advanced considerably, growing research effort is now directed toward translating this knowledge into applications for agriculture, horticulture, and crop breeding.

In this presentation, I will highlight two recent research focuses of my group related to photosynthesis. The first concerns new methods for analyzing photosynthesis "in action." We use harmonically oscillating light to systematically probe the dynamic responses of photosynthesis and infer the kinetic properties of its regulatory mechanisms. Combined with machine learning, this approach is also being explored for applications in plant stress detection and classification.

title: Varustelu kasvattaa ilmastolaskua – armeijoiden päästöt jäävät yhä piiloon
content:
Johanna Kohvakka

Kun listataan maailman suurimpia kasvihuonekaasupäästäjiä, asevoimat jäävät yleensä luetteloiden ulkopuolelle.

Se ei tarkoita, että niiden ilmastovaikutus olisi pieni. Ongelma on pikemminkin siinä, ettei yhtä, kattavaa lukua ole helppo muodostaa, sillä sotilaallisia päästöjä lasketaan ja raportoidaan hajanaisesti.

Yhdysvaltain armeijan, Pentagonin, sotilasoperaatioiden ja tukikohtien kasvihuonekaasupäästöjen on arvioitu olleen vuonna 2023 noin 48 miljoonaa tonnia hiilidioksidiekvivalenttia. Se on enemmän kuin esimerkiksi koko Suomen samana vuonna tuottamat kasvihuonekaasupäästöt ilman maankäyttösektoria, jotka olivat 41 miljoonaa tonnia.

Vertailu ei ole aivan yksi yhteen, sillä kansallisten päästöinventaarioiden ja Pentagonin päästölaskennan rajaukset poikkeavat toisistaan. Se kertoo silti mittakaavasta: yhden valtion puolustushallinnon toiminnan ilmastovaikutus vastaa keskikokoisen teollisuusmaan vuotuisia päästöjä.

Yhdysvaltain armeijaa määritelläänkin usein maailman instituutioiden suurimmaksi kasvihuonekaasupäästäjäksi. Tutkimuksissa sen vuotuisten päästöjen on todettu ylittävän yli sadan valtion päästöt erikseen tarkasteltuina.

title: WITNESS releases report on five lessons from the Nepal floods for verifying what’s real
content:
WITNESS has released a new report examining five lessons from the Nepal floods for verifying what’s real in the age of AI. Drawing on cases investigated by fact-checkers and on WITNESS’ work, the report examines the limits of AI detection, the growing role of technology companies in determining what is real, and why human investigation remains essential in a crisis.

On 26 August, a glacial collapse high on the Nepal-Tibet border sent a wall of ice, rock and water down the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli valleys. More than 1,380 people were killed in Nepal and over 5,100 remained missing. Within hours, social media filled with footage of the disaster. Some of it was real, but much of it was not. Fact-checkers identified AI-generated videos, footage recycled from other disasters, and authentic footage that was mistakenly questioned as AI-generated. Some fake videos also disputed the cause of the disaster, attributing the floods to a Chinese-built dam or a missile strike rather than the documented glacial collapse.

title: Pehmeät asiat ovat kovimpia kilpailutekijöitä
content:
Minna Mattila-Aalto

Mitä tapahtuu, kun organisaatio haluaa parantaa tuottavuuttaan? Se alkaa mitata enemmän. Entä jos juuri siksi tuottavuus ei kasva?

Havaintojeni mukaan organisaatiot alkavat mitata yhä enemmän suoritteita, käyttöastetta, läpimenoaikoja, kustannuksia ja tehokkuutta. Mittaaminen tuntuu turvalliselta, sillä luvut näyttävät objektiivisilta. Niiden avulla voidaan vertailla, ohjata ja tehdä päätöksiä.

Entä jos kaikkein tärkein jääkin mittaamatta?

Ihmiset eivät tee sitä, mitä mitataan. He tekevät sitä, minkä kokevat merkitykselliseksi ja mahdolliseksi.

Kun mittarit alkavat ohjata toimintaa liikaa, huomio siirtyy helposti itse tavoitteesta mittarin optimointiin. Silloin voidaan saada parempia tunnuslukuja ilman, että työ tai sen vaikuttavuus oikeasti paranee.

Tämä on suomalaisen tuottavuuskeskustelun sokea piste.

Mittaamme tehokkaasti sitä, mikä on helposti laskettavissa. Sen sijaan ne tekijät, joista tulevaisuuden tuottavuus rakentuu, jäävät liian usein näkymättömiksi.

title: Narrative Failure: Russia and the West have a Storytelling Problem
content:
Audiences respond to stories that drive toward an achievable climax. In the big movie of this summer, Odysseus faces endless challenges on his way home to Ithaca, but we know his goal is to reunite with Penelope and Telemachus and that he is handy with a bow. The story proceeds in an arc to his ultimate triumph.

Both Russia and the West have tried to promote a logical arc for the end of the Ukraine war, but their narratives have lacked goals and means. Both sides have failed to define exactly what they want, or to convince the world they have the ability to achieve it.

After Russia’s full-scale invasion, Western nations promised to give Ukraine “whatever it takes” without ever defining “it.” President Joe Biden’s administration never fixed a goal of entirely rolling back the invasion, nor did its European allies.

Three months after the invasion, Biden even implied Russia might keep some of its early territorial gains. He said the US would help Ukraine fight “further” aggression so it would “be in the strongest possible position at the negotiating table.”

title: Jäänmurtajat jäämerellisen vallan symboleina Venäjällä ja Kanadassa
content: Tässä meristrategian teoriaperinteeseen kytkeytyvässä artikkelissa tarkastellaan viitteitä Venäjän ja Kanadan merellisestä vallasta Jäämerellä kulttuuristen teennösten eli artefaktien kautta. Tarkastelukehyksenä toimii Andrew Lambertin kehittelemä teoria, jonka mukaisesti valtion merellinen valta rakentuu sen merelliselle kulttuuri-identiteetille. Artikkelissa huomio kiinnitetään nimenomaisesti jäämerelliseen kulttuuri-identiteettiin, jota symboloivaksi tulkitaan polaarijäänmurtajaviittausten ilmentyminen kansallisessa kulttuurissa. Ilmentymien määrää ja merkitystä tarkastellaan viidessä kategoriassa: muistomerkit, musiikki, rahat, seremoniat ja postimerkit. Tarkastelusta käy ilmi, että Venäjällä kulttuurisissa teennöksissä viittauksia polaarijäänmurtajiin esiintyy selvästi Kanadaa enemmän. Lambertin teorian valossa Venäjällä olisi siis paremmat lähtökohdat merelliselle vallalle Jäämerellä. Kanadankin kulttuurissa kuitenkin on jäämerellisyyteen viittaavia piirteitä. Kanadalle olisi nykyisistä lähtökohdistaan verrattain helppo valita kehittää kulttuuriaan nykyistä jäämerellisemmäksi ja siten luoda edellytyksiä jäämerellisen valtansa kasvattamiselle.

title: Meta Tests Muse AI Agent Calls That Are Actually Made By Humans in a Call Center
content:
Last week, Meta executives announced that its much-hyped AI agent, Muse, had a new feature: It could call businesses for you to do things like make a restaurant reservation or a haircut appointment. But in reality, Meta is testing having these calls being made by human beings in call centers, 404 Media has learned.

“We just expanded the @muse beta for outbound calls to US businesses,” Ryan Fox, the principal engineer on Muse posted on X on Sept. 16. Alexandr Wang, Meta’s chief AI officer, posted “we’re expanding our phone beta for muse!” 

Internally, however, the company announced the features to employees and said that it had “added a human agent layer for calls to get completed,” and that “Muse human agent calls [sic] is ready for company dogfooding,” or testing. 

“Muse doesn’t just dial a number. It calls a business on your behalf, handles the conversation, completes your request, and reports back with a transcript and a summary,” the internal message board post to employees, seen by 404 Media, reads. “It also no longer works alone. Muse is now able to hand requests to a trained human agent, who places the call and works it through.”
snippet: Last week, Meta executives announced that its much-hyped AI agent, Muse, had a new feature: It could call businesses for you to do things like make a restaurant reservation or a haircut appointment.

title: South Sudan: Authorities must protect civic space ahead of scheduled national elections
content:
Following the announced dissolution of South Sudan’s Revitalized Transitional Government of National Unity, a decisive step towards the country’s first-ever elections scheduled for 22 December, Amnesty International’s Regional Director for East and Southern Africa, Tigere Chagutah, said:

“Ahead of these long-awaited and historic elections, South Sudanese authorities must ensure that a conducive environment exists for people to vote and stand in elections, including respect for and enjoyment of human rights, and freedom from discrimination and arbitrary or unnecessary and disproportionate restrictions.

“The legitimacy of any election depends not only on whether it is held, but on whether people can exercise their rights freely, safely and equally. For years, Amnesty International and other organizations have documented the repressive tactics deployed by the South Sudanese authorities to silence dissent, detain critics, and restrict freedom of expression and the right to protest.

title: Analysis: Nepal’s $20m ‘loss-and-damage’ claim only covers 0.7% of flood costs
content:
• Nepal’s needs
  • Requests vs pledges
  • ‘Rapid response’

    • The Nepali government has requested $20m from the UN fund for “loss and damage”, following the devastating floods that hit the country in late August.

    This amounts to just 0.7% of the $2.7bn it has estimated in “physical damage” to infrastructure and “economic losses” from the flooding, according to Carbon Brief analysis.

    The $20m request would, nevertheless, make Nepal the fourth-largest claimant to the UN loss-and-damage fund, which is intended to help deal with climate-related disasters.

    Developing countries have already made 176 applications to the UN fund for responding to loss and damage, requesting, in total, $2.8bn to help recover from a variety of damaging events, such as drought, floods and storms.

    Yet, to date, predominantly developed nations have only pledged $0.8bn to support the fund.

    This means requests to the fund are already three times larger than the total amount pledged, raising questions about its potential to respond to emergencies.

    As yet, no funding has been paid out of the fund to developing countries grappling with intensifying and more frequent climate change-induced disasters since it was established in 2023.

title: Transformations. A DARIAH Journal launches second issue on “The Past”
content:
How do digital methods shape the ways we understand, preserve and interpret the past? The second issue of Transformations. A DARIAH Journal, dedicated to “The Past”, brings together five articles exploring this question. Following the inaugural issue on workflows, the new issue examines both the possibilities and the challenges of working with historical sources and cultural heritage in a digital world.

As guest editors Agiatis Bernardou and Georgios Artopoulos explain in their introduction, “these contributions suggest that the past is never simply waiting to be retrieved. It must be identified, organised, connected, preserved and interpreted.”

The published articles address topical issues: information extraction from bibliographic data, data migration as a memory preservation process, data feminism in the work with historical newspapers, critical perspectives on historical statistics, the interaction between wikibase and memory institutions collections. Together, they provide novel methodological insights in the spirit of Open Science, making their datasets available for reuse.

title: Could Cuba Become a "Silent Gaza"? U.S. Fuel Blockade Aims to "Asphyxiate" Island: Top Cuban Diplomat
content:
As the United Nations General Assembly opens in New York, we speak with senior Cuban diplomat Carlos Fernández de Cossío, who says the Trump administration is seeking to “asphyxiate the people of Cuba into submission.” On Friday, millions in Cuba lost power in what was at least the sixth major blackout since President Trump cut off fuel shipments to the island in January. The fuel blockade comes on top of the six-decade-long U.S. economic embargo and countless attempts to topple the communist government.

“We will do all we can to stop any nation, the U.S. or any nation, from taking over Cuba,” says Fernández de Cossío, who has served as deputy Cuban foreign minister since 2022.

title: Budjettikeskustelu pyöri abortissa – Orpo: ”Tästä ei pidä tehdä nyt kysymystä naisten oikeuksista”
content:
Ensi vuoden budjetin lähetekeskustelussa eduskunnassa taitettiin peistä myös hallituksen terveydenhuollon asiakasmaksujen korotuksiin sisältyvästä aborttilinjauksesta.

Petteri Orpon (kok.) hallitus päätyi budjettiriihessään korottamaan asiakasmaksuja mutta rajasi synnytyksiin, keskenmenoihin tai näihin liittyviin komplikaatioihin liittyvät toimenpiteet asiakasmaksujen ulkopuolelle. Samaan luokkaan sijoittuvat myös lääketieteellisistä syistä tehdyt abortit, jotka ovat tähän saakka olleet edellisten tavoin asiakasmaksujen piirissä.

Sen sijaan sellaisista sosiaalisista syistä tehtävistä aborteista, jotka eivät esimerkiksi raskauden myöhäisemmän vaiheen vuoksi enää hoidu lääkkeellä, peritään jatkossakin asiakasmaksu, jonka hallitus korottaa nykyisestä 230 eurosta enintään 257 euroon.

Kiistassa on siis kyse on paitsi asiakasmaksun korotuksesta myös eri syistä tehtävien aborttien erottelusta joko maksun piiriin tai sen ulkopuolelle kuuluviksi. Svenska Ylen mukaan erottelua vaati hallituksen neuvotteluissa kristillisdemokraatit.

title: Scholarship applications for Wikimania Santiago are now open
content:
What does “The Internet we want” mean to you? What impact have you had on the Wikimedia movement to date and what do you hope to contribute in the future?

These are just some of the questions in the scholarship application to attend Wikimania 2027 in Santiago, Chile. The application form is now live and will be open through the end of the day on October 31, 2026. Applications will be accepted in any language, although the three official languages for this year’s event are preferred – Spanish, Portuguese, and English.

Scholarships to Wikimania 2027 cover travel to Santiago, hotel accommodation, and registration for the conference, which will take place from August 18 to 21.

Successful scholarship applicants are expected to volunteer for at least 4 to 6 hours during the event, in addition to participating in conference sessions and activities. Each year, Wikimania scholars form connections and friendships with other scholars from around the world. They also report that volunteering as a scholar gave them a strong sense of teamwork.

title: Is Latvia “one big training ground” where you cannot pick mushrooms?
content:
The National Armed Forces (NAF) Law defines a military training ground as a geographically designated area of the territorial sea or land territory of the Republic of Latvia, as well as the airspace above this territory, where military exercises, manoeuvres involving the use of training and combat ammunition, tactical training and host-nation support are carried out, the ministry explained.

There are five military training grounds in Latvia:

  • the Ādaži military training ground;
  • the Mežaine military training ground in Kurzeme;
  • the Lāčusils military training ground in Vidzeme;
  • the Meža Mackeviči military training ground in Latgale;
  • the Sēlija military training ground.

    • Latvia also has two military aviation training areas: in Ādaži and Jūrmalciems.

    According to the MoD, the total area of the military training grounds is approximately 43 000 hectares, of which the Sēlija military training ground occupies 24 500 hectares.

title: E-RIHS and Università Telematica Pegaso join the ECHOES consortium
content:
ECHOES is pleased to announce that E-RIHS has joined the ECHOES consortium as a beneficiary along with the Università Telematica Pegaso who has joined as an affiliated entity of ENCATC.

E-RIHS ERIC (European Research Infrastructure for Heritage Science) is the European legal consortium dedicated to advancing heritage science. It offers physical access to state-of-the-art facilities and resources, with data-driven research approaches, enabling the coordinated use of fixed and mobile analytical instruments, archives, reference collections, and digital tools, all supported by specialised training. For ECHOES, E-RIHS is responsible for long-term sustainability, bringing the interdisciplinary heritage science community’s contribution into the field.

title: European experts call for immediate Grade 1 protection and adaptive reuse of British Barracks at Fort Chambray, Malta
content:
A European expert team has released a Report on the preservation of the British Barracks at Fort Chambray in Gozo, Malta. An exceptionally important element of Gozo’s architectural, social and European heritage, the Barracks were constructed at the turn of the 20th century as married quarters for British military families, and are now threatened with demolition to make way for a new five-storey spa hotel, which would incorporate only a reconstructed version of the historic arcaded façade.

The British Barracks at Fort Chambray were listed among the 7 Most Endangered heritage sites in Europe for 2026, in the framework of the 7 Most Endangered Programme run by Europa Nostra with the support of the European Investment Bank Institute. The site was nominated by Din l-Art Ħelwa – the National Trust for Malta.

The European experts recommend protecting the British Barracks through Grade 1 scheduling and pursuing their adaptive reuse, arguing that conservation and economic development can be mutually supportive and that the building can contribute to the future sustainable development of Fort Chambray and Gozo.

title: Technology-facilitated trafficking: How Bangladeshi migrants become victims of recruitment in Cambodia
content:
17,031 Bangladeshi migrants travelled to Cambodia for work from June 2023 to July 2026

Originally published on Global Voices

The Streets of Phnom Penh. Image via Flickr by ND Strupler. CC BY-2.0.

This report features interviews and infographics by Abdur Rahaman, Atkia Fariha, A. K. M. Hasanat Alimoon, Lamesha Akter, and Shanta Akter for the Data Journalism Course at the University of Liberal Arts Bangladesh.

Sajjad Hossain was 23 in 2025, a fresh graduate from Comilla city in eastern Bangladesh, when a job advertisement reached him through a WhatsApp group. It promised data-entry work in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, with a wage several times what he could earn at home, and a middleman handling the visa process. Within one month, he had signed the paperwork, paid roughly BDT 450,000 (USD 3,640), and boarded a flight to Cambodia. Within 48 hours of landing in Phnom Penh, his passport had disappeared into a company safe, and so had the job he had been promised.

title: January 2026 Protests: Death Sentences of Mehdi Nazer and Mahnaz Chardouli Overturned by Supreme Court
content:
According to HRANA, the death sentences of Mehdi Nazer and Mahnaz Chardouli have been overturned by the country’s highest judicial authority.

Based on information received by HRANA, the Supreme Court has overturned the death sentences of Mehdi Nazer and Mahnaz Chardouli, who were arrested in connection with the nationwide protests of January 2026. Mehdi Nazer is currently incarcerated in Greater Tehran Prison, while Mahnaz Chardouli is being held in Qarchak Prison in Varamin.

The two prisoners were previously tried in a joint case by Branch 15 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court, presided over by Judge Abolghasem Salavati, and sentenced to death on charges including destruction of public property, participation in illegal gatherings, and assembly and collusion against national security. The same judicial branch also sentenced the two political prisoners, along with another defendant in the case, Atefeh Nazer, to 10 years in prison each.

Mehdi Nazer and Mahnaz Chardouli were arrested in Tehran on January 11, 2026, in connection with the nationwide protests.

title: Niger: Junta Strips 5 More Exiled Critics of Nationality
content:
(Nairobi) – Niger’s junta has provisionally stripped five more exiled opposition figures of their nationality, extending a controversial policy increasingly used against critics of the military authorities, Human Rights Watch said today.

On September 17, 2026, Gen. Abdourahamane Tiani, who has led Niger’s junta since the July 2023 coup, signed a decree removing the nationality of five prominent Nigeriens living in exile. The decree derives authority from a 2024 order creating a national terrorism database with overbroad inclusion criteria and inadequate due process requirements and safeguards for redress. The order jeopardizes privacy and data protection rights and increases the risk of statelessness. 

“The Niger junta’s use of a terrorism database to deprive people of their nationality without any meaningful legal safeguards raises serious human rights concerns,” said Ilaria Allegrozzi, senior Sahel researcher at Human Rights Watch. “Nationality is a fundamental legal status, not a privilege that governments can take from people for political reasons.”

title: Ciné-club Nordique: Girl Picture
content:
Le Ciné-Club Nordic consacre son édition d’octobre au cinéma finlandais avec le film Girl Picture (2022), réalisé par Alli Haapasalo. Organisée dans le cadre de la Journée internationale de la fille, cette séance est proposée en collaboration avec l’Ambassade de Finlande. À cette occasion, une jeune fille sera accueillie comme « ambassadrice d’un jour », en écho aux thèmes du film.

Girl Picture suit trois jeunes femmes, Mimmi, Rönkkö et Emma, à l’aube de l’âge adulte. Meilleures amies, Mimmi et Rönkkö se soutiennent sans condition et rêvent d’une vie pleine d’aventures, d’expériences et de passion. Emma, quant à elle, a consacré sa vie au patinage artistique et à la réussite. Lorsque leurs chemins se croisent, de nouvelles possibilités s’ouvrent à elles. Entre premiers amours, désir, plaisir, amitié et quête de soi, leurs vies prennent des directions inattendues. Trois vendredis suffisent à bouleverser leur monde.

title: Toimittajan unelmakirjastoon mahtuvat kaikki
content:
Voiko tietokirja olla yhtä koukuttava kuin romaani?

”Totta kai. Jotkut tietokirjat rakentuvat dekkarimaisesti. Pyrin itsekin pitämään lukijan mielenkiintoa yllä kertomalla, miten olen päässyt jonkin ilmiön jäljille ja miten sitä olen selvittänyt. Jotkut tutkimuksistani ovat kuin rikostutkimuksia. Juuri tuo selvittämisen prosessi tekee tekstistä koukuttavaa.”

Onko jokin kirja, joka on sinulle erityisen tärkeä?

”Stephen Kingin romaani Kirous, jonka luin kuusitoistavuotiaana. Luin sitä matkalla kotoa kouluun, noin tunnin mittaisella metromatkalla Pietarin aamuruuhkassa. Kun pääsin kohtaan, jossa päähenkilö kuihtuu ihan luihin asti, se oli niin vaikuttava, että pyörryin ahtaassa vaunussa, jossa oli huono ilma. Jouduin jäämään seuraavalla pysäkillä pois, ja metrohenkilökunta tuli auttamaan. Se oli hyvin konkreettinen kokemus siitä, miten vaikuttavaa kirjallisuus voi olla.”

Millainen esiintymispaikka kirjasto on sinulle?

title: Džerela Karpat -yhtye tuo musiikkiterveiset Ukrainasta
content:
Džerela Karpatin muodostaa kuusi virtuoosimaista muusikkoa, joilta löytyy karismaa, ammattitaitoa, energiaa ja vauhtia. Yhtyeen ohjelmistoon kuuluu vanhaa kansanmusiikkia Ukrainan länsiosista, ja soittimina ovat ikivanhat kansansoittimet, kuten symbaali, nai (panhuilu) ja okariina.

Ryhmä tulee Suomeen jo neljännen kerran. Syys-lokakuussa 2026 muusikot esittävät konserttiohjelmaansa Musiikkia Karpaattien vuorilta. Ohjelmassa kuullaan Ukrainan pienten etnisten ryhmien – Karpaattien vuoristolaisten, hutsulien ja lemkien – heleitä ja eloisia, omintakeisia musiikkiteoksia. Vuorilla asuvan kansan musiikissa kuuluu tunteiden ja kokemusten koko kirjo. Värikkään lisän Džerela Karpatin konserttiohjelmaan tuo laulaja Andrij Boženskin mukana olo. Hänen ohjelmistoonsa kuuluu tunnettuja ukrainalaisia kansanlauluja. Kuusihenkisen ryhmän tuo Suomeen Ukrainan kansainvälinen kulttuurikeskus.

title: Tutkimus osoittaa: Eläimetkin ystävystyvät
content:
Ihminen on siitä erikoinen eläinlaji, että se haluaa muodostaa sosiaalisia suhteita toisten eläinlajien kanssa. Sama pätee kuitenkin myös muihin kädellisiin, kertoo uusi tutkimus.

Se ei sinänsä ole uutta: jo pitkään on tiedetty, että eri eläinlajit ovat tekemisissä keskenään etenkin, jos siitä on niille hyötyä. Primates-lehdessä julkaistu tutkimus kuitenkin viittaa siihen, että eläimet vuorovaikuttavat keskenään myös puhtaasti sosiaalisista syistä.

Tutkijat kokosivat 1970-luvulta vuoteen 2025 asti tiedot 427:sta kädellisten ja muiden lajien kohtaamisesta. Yleisimpiä tapoja olivat leikkiminen ja turkinhoito, mutta kädelliset myös kantoivat muita eläimiä, käpertyivät niiden viereen, jakoivat niiden kanssa ruokaa tai jopa adoptoivat niitä.

Tutkimuksissa on esimerkiksi havaittu, kuinka lehtiapina silittelee oravaa, gorilla tuudittelee korvamakia ja makaki hoitaa kulkukoiran turkkia, Länsi-Australian ja Oxfordin yliopistojen apulaisprofessori Cyril Grueter kirjoittaa The Conversation -lehdessä.

Osa vuorovaikutuksesta saattaa selittyä sillä, että kädellisillä on luultua laajempi kyky sosiaaliseen joustavuuteen, uteliaisuuteen ja suvaitsevaisuuteen muita eläinlajeja kohtaan, hän arvelee.

title: Romanian Ex-Presidential Candidate Held in €1.1M Fraud Case
content:
Romanian prosecutors have asked a Bucharest court to place former presidential candidate Călin Georgescu and businessman Ionel Rusen in pretrial detention for 30 days over an alleged organized criminal group and a 1.1 million euro ($1.26 million) fraud. 

According to a prosecution filing reviewed by OCCRP, investigators allege Georgescu, Rusen and Italian businessman Massimiliano Arena persuaded a Romanian businessman to transfer money as a guarantee for a foreign credit line that never materialized. Prosecutors say Georgescu initiated the arrangement and introduced Rusen as someone capable of securing the financing.

The victim first transferred 1 million euros and later another 100,000 euros after being told the loan could be increased from six million euros to 15 million, the filing says. Prosecutors detained Georgescu and Rusen for 24 hours following searches that uncovered electronic devices, signal jammers and documents suspected of being false. The filing also cites secretly recorded conversations in which Georgescu discussed buying property in Italy and seeking political asylum, which prosecutors cited in arguing that he posed a flight risk.

title: The Digital Dada Library: Discover the Archive That Preserves the Original Publications of the Experimental Anti-Art Movement Online
content:
Critical theorists like Theodor Adorno may have overreached in claiming that all mass culture is mediocre, mechanized propaganda made to justify the status quo. But that doesn’t mean they were entirely wrong. Over and over we see even the most subversive art, literature, film, and music has a way of being tamed and Bowdlerized. Global mega-corporate industries don’t need to censor what they don’t like; they only need to buy it, rebrand it, or price it out of reach.

So what? Why do we need challenging, independent art when we have endless entertainment? Is the concept a nostalgic, elitist, Eurocentric idea? Artists have justified the need for art since antiquity, with poetic and logical arguments of every kind. But Dada artists of the early 20th century broke ranks, building their movement on the insight that no defense could possibly mean anything when it came to art’s purpose, especially in the face of the technocratic slaughter of World War I.

title: AI anxiety is sweeping the globe — and cutting across party lines
content:
The freakout over artificial intelligence that started in Silicon Valley and led to growing American calls to pause development has swept Western countries.

A new POLITICO Poll finds that pluralities of adults in the U.S., Canada and Europe want to pause AI development regardless of their political leanings — and most believe there’s a real risk the technology could destroy humanity.

Pluralities of respondents in several countries say it’s ok for their country to fall behind others in the development of AI if it means being more responsible and secure when advancing it. And they’re more likely to expect AI will destroy jobs rather than create them. 

This is coming as world leaders are gathering in New York for the United Nations General Assembly and grappling with how to regulate the technology — or not.

title: Trump praises relations with Burnham despite tensions over AI and Iran
content:
US president calls UK prime minister ‘a natural businessperson’ as leaders meet at UN assembly in New York

Donald Trump has asserted his relationship with the UK is “more up” with Andy Burnham than under Keir Starmer despite tensions between the two countries on a range of thorny issues including regulation of artificial intelligence, the Chagos islands and the war in Iran.

At their first face-to-face meeting, the US president praised Burnham, who sat nervously alongside him, as a “natural businessperson”, saying he thought he had “lots of assets on his side” and would be a “great” prime minister.

title: Ruka Nordic avaa talven – 25 vuotta kansainvälistä kisatunnelmaa
content:
Talvi alkaa Rukalta

Ruka Nordic on Hiihtoliiton omistama yhtiö, joka on viime vuosina kehittänyt tapahtumaa oman organisaationsa voimin. Kumppanuus- ja VIP-myynnistä vastaavan Mika Weckströmin mukaan kiinnostus tapahtumaa kohtaan on ollut yritysten keskuudessa erittäin hyvää.

”On ollut hienoa huomata, kuinka vahvasti Ruka Nordic kiinnostaa yrityksiä. Keskusteluissa ei katsota enää pelkästään tämän vuoden tapahtumaan, vaan rakennetaan jo pidempää yhteistyötä tuleville vuosille”, Weckström kertoo.

Maailmancupin kilpailut on sovittu Rukalle aina vuoteen 2033 asti, mikä antaa hyvän pohjan tapahtuman ja kumppanuuksien pitkäjänteiselle kehittämiselle.

Tapahtuma tavoittaa vuosittain suuren yleisön niin Suomessa kuin kansainvälisesti. Televisiolähetykset tavoittavat 70 miljoonaa katsojaa maailmalla, ja Suomessa Ylen, Yle Areenan ja Viaplayn kautta tapahtumaa seuraa 1,2 miljoonaa katsojaa. Rukalle odotetaan kisaviikonlopun aikana noin 30 000 kävijää ja 1 800 VIP-vierasta. Kilpailuissa nähdään noin 400 kansainvälisen tason urheilijaa.

Tapahtuma näkyy koko alueella

title: Pisa-tulokset velvoittavat arvioimaan S2-opetusta
content:
Suomen laskevat Pisa-tulokset ovat poliitikoille kuin Harry Potterin Iseeviot-peili: se ei näytä totuutta vaan sen, mitä katsoja haluaa nähdä. Yksi näkee tulosten laskun syynä kännykät, toinen koulutusleikkaukset, kolmas inkluusion.

Jokainen löytää juuri sen syyn, jota on vaatinut koko vaalikauden korjattavaksi. Kukaan ei muuta mieltään, mikään ei korjaannu, ja sama kuvio toistuu seuraavan raportin saapuessa.

Erityisesti maahanmuuttajavastaisten poliitikkojen – kuten perussuomalaisten – peilistä katsoo joka kerta sama kuva: maahanmuuttajataustaiset lapset ovat aiheuttaneet Suomen tulosromahduksen. Niin tälläkin kertaa. Ministeriporrasta myöten annettiin ymmärtää, että maahanmuuttajalapset ovat syypäitä Suomen tuloslaskun jatkumiseen.

Tämä ei yksinkertaisesti pidä paikkaansa. Sen olisi huomannut avaamalla raportin – jo pelkän sisällysluettelon lukeminen olisi riittänyt. Lukutaito heikkeni Suomessa suunnilleen saman verran kuin OECD-maissa keskimäärin. Suomen laskukäyrä on lähes täsmälleen samanlainen kuin esimerkiksi Japanin ja Etelä-Korean, joissa maahanmuutto on olematonta.

title: Russian Fertilizer: Nourishing the Roots of War
content:
Russian fertilizer makers have largely escaped sanctions, despite their importance for revenues, the provision of war materiel, and strategic leverage. There are no sanctions on products entering the US, and the European Union (EU) only imposed curbs in mid-2025.

As a result, the Russian fertilizer industry has enjoyed a booming export market in the EU and US since the full-scale invasion of Ukraine. At the same time, the Kremlin’s manipulation of European gas supply has devastated EU manufacturers, enhancing opportunities for exporters.

And the proprietors of these businesses, such as Ultrachem’s Dmitry Mazepin and Eurochem’s Andrey Melnichenko, are not neutral businessmen. They are close to the Russian leadership, have been personally sanctioned by the EU, and provide vital explosives for the war.

Russia’s fertilizer industry has become a major economic and military security threat, which Western allies need to tackle.

title: People Training OpenAI’s AI Fired for Using AI to Train the AI
content:
OpenAI has an army of contractors who read real ChatGPT users’ prompts and other data to help improve the chatbot’s responses. The idea is that the contractors provide an, obviously, human touch to OpenAI’s models. Well, not all of the contractors are doing that. 404 Media has found multiple contractors hired to improve OpenAI’s models have been fired for using AI to train the AI. That’s not great for the models themselves, but there is also obviously a great irony in AI training companies working for OpenAI firing people for using AI when OpenAI’s whole thing is to make people use AI at work.

Some AI models already exhibit signs of “model collapse,” which is where AI models further trained on AI-generated text can become worse and worse. In this case, some of the people hired to partially stop that happening are themselves using AI-generated responses to train OpenAI’s models.

One contractor said they see people using AI “all the time and people are let go for it all the time, it’s pretty much the one thing that will get you kicked off ASAP.” The person said, “in a group of thousands there are tons that have been caught.”
